chapters.title: The Childhood Promise
content: The story begins in 1969, during the height of the counterculture movement.
A group of young boys in Japan create a secret base in a vacant lot.
They play games and imagine adventures to save the world.
The boys write down their dreams in a notebook called the 'Book of Prophecy'.
They imagine a villain who will try to destroy the world.
The boys promise to stop the villain and become heroes.
The leader of the group is Kenji Endo, a dreamer with a big heart.
Other members include Yoshitsune, Maruo, and Donkey.
The group also includes a strange girl named Kiriko.
The boys grow up and go their separate ways in life.
The year is now 1997, and the world is changing.
A mysterious cult known as the 'Friends' is gaining power.
The cult leader is known only as 'Friend'.
The childhood memories of the boys are about to come back to haunt them.

chapters.title: The Return of Kenji
content: Kenji Endo now runs a convenience store in Tokyo.
He has given up his dreams and lives a simple life.
Kenji is raising his niece, Kanna, after her mother's death.
He receives a letter from his childhood friend, Donkey.
The letter mentions a man named 'Friend' and a prophecy.
Donkey believes that the cult leader is connected to their past.
Kenji is curious but dismisses the letter as nonsense.
He attends his childhood friend's funeral and sees the others.
The reunion brings back memories of their secret base.
Kenji learns that Donkey was murdered by the cult.
He discovers that the 'Book of Prophecy' has been leaked.
The prophecies in the book are coming true in real life.
Kenji realizes that their childhood games have become real.
He must find out who 'Friend' is and stop him.

chapters.title: The Prophet
content: Kenji investigates the cult and its mysterious leader.
He learns that 'Friend' has predicted several disasters.
The predictions are exactly what the boys wrote in their book.
Kenji begins to suspect that one of his childhood friends is 'Friend'.
He reconnects with Yoshitsune, Maruo, and the others.
They are shocked to learn about the prophecies coming true.
Kenji remembers a boy named Fukubei who was in their group.
Fukubei was quiet and often overlooked by the others.
He was obsessed with science fiction and robots.
Fukubei disappeared mysteriously after their childhood.
Kenji suspects that Fukubei might be 'Friend'.
The friends decide to investigate the cult together.
They must uncover the truth before the world is destroyed.
The childhood promise to save the world is now a reality.

chapters.title: The Cult of Friendship
content: The 'Friends' cult has millions of followers worldwide.
The cult promotes peace, unity, and friendship.
However, behind the facade lies a sinister agenda.
The cult uses fear and manipulation to control people.
'Friend' is worshipped as a prophet and savior.
His followers are willing to die for him.
Kenji and his friends try to infiltrate the cult.
They discover that the cult has its own military forces.
The cult is preparing for a global catastrophe.
Kenji learns that 'Friend' plans to destroy the world.
The destruction will fulfill the final prophecy in the book.
Kenji must stop 'Friend' before it is too late.
The friends gather more allies to fight the cult.
The battle for the world's future has begun.

chapters.title: The New Year's Eve
content: The date is December 31, 1999.
The cult has predicted that the world will end at midnight.
People around the world are terrified and desperate.
Kenji and his friends prepare to confront 'Friend'.
They believe that 'Friend' is going to trigger an apocalypse.
The friends gather at the secret base from their childhood.
They remember their promise to protect the world.
Kenji leads the group to the cult's headquarters.
They face heavy resistance from cult soldiers.
Kenji fights his way through the compound.
He finally confronts 'Friend' face to face.
The identity of 'Friend' is revealed as someone unexpected.
Kenji is shocked by the revelation.
The battle for the world's survival reaches its climax.

chapters.title: The Truth Revealed
content: 'Friend' is revealed to be a man named Katsumata.
Katsumata was a boy who wanted to join their group.
He was always rejected and left out by the others.
Katsumata held a grudge against the group for years.
He created the cult to fulfill his childhood fantasies.
Katsumata wanted to become the villain from their stories.
He wanted to destroy the world to get revenge.
Kenji realizes that their exclusion created the monster.
He feels guilt and responsibility for Katsumata's actions.
Kenji fights Katsumata in a final showdown.
Katsumata is defeated, and the apocalypse is prevented.
However, the cult continues to exist after his death.
'Friend' has become a symbol greater than one person.
The battle is not truly over.

chapters.title: The New Millennium
content: The world survives the New Year's Eve of 1999.
People celebrate the new millennium with relief and joy.
Kenji is hailed as a hero for stopping 'Friend'.
He returns to his simple life with Kanna.
The friends try to move on from the traumatic events.
However, the cult continues to grow and spread.
A new leader has taken the mantle of 'Friend'.
The new 'Friend' is even more dangerous than before.
The prophecies begin again, more terrifying than ever.
Kenji realizes that the cult will never truly die.
He must fight the cult once more.
Kanna is drawn into the conflict as she grows older.
The legacy of 'Friend' haunts the next generation.
The battle continues across the decades.

chapters.title: The Generation Gap
content: Time jumps forward to the year 2015.
Kenji is older and tired of fighting.
He has passed his knowledge and mission to Kanna.
Kanna is now a young woman who carries her uncle's ideals.
She has her own group of friends to help her.
The new generation faces the same enemy.
The cult has evolved and adapted to the modern world.
'Friend' is still worshipped by millions of followers.
Kanna discovers that the cult is planning another catastrophe.
She must prevent the new prophecy from coming true.
Kenji's friends help guide and protect Kanna.
The old heroes and new heroes unite for the battle.
The fight against 'Friend' is a war across generations.
The spirit of the childhood promise lives on.

chapters.title: The Final Prophecy
content: The cult reveals its final and most terrifying prophecy.
The prophecy predicts the extinction of humanity.
The world is thrown into chaos and fear.
Kanna and her friends fight to uncover the truth.
They discover that the prophecy is connected to a virus.
The virus was created by the cult to end the world.
Kanna must find the cure before it is too late.
She confronts the new 'Friend' and learns the truth.
The new 'Friend' is someone close to their group.
Betrayal and heartbreak follow the revelation.
Kanna and her allies fight a desperate battle.
The future of humanity hangs in the balance.
The final prophecy must be stopped at all costs.
The story reaches its epic conclusion.

chapters.title: The Legacy of Heroes
content: Kanna and her friends successfully stop the final prophecy.
The world is saved once again by the brave few.
The cult is dismantled after years of struggle.
Kanna emerges as a hero and a symbol of hope.
Kenji passes away peacefully, knowing the battle is over.
His legacy lives on through Kanna and the others.
The childhood dream of saving the world is finally fulfilled.
The friends remember their promise and their journey.
The world has changed because of their courage.
The story reflects on the importance of friendship.
The battle against evil is never truly over.
But the heroes have given the world a chance to live.
The spirit of the 20th century boys endures.
The manga ends with hope for the future.

chapters.title: The Final Chapter: A New Beginning
content: The story concludes with a final reflection on the characters.
The friends who fought together have all found their peace.
Kanna continues to protect the world from new threats.
The legacy of 'Friend' is examined and understood.
The cult was a product of loneliness and rejection.
The heroes showed that friendship can overcome anything.
The childhood games were not just games after all.
They were training for the real battle to come.
The story ends with Kanna visiting the old secret base.
She remembers the dreams of the 20th century boys.
The spirit of adventure and hope lives on.
New generations will carry the torch forward.
The world will always need heroes like Kenji and his friends.
The manga ends with a powerful message of hope and love.
